Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

PR#ERRED SHUT HEIGHTS FOR

CD 



1. Scope — Prescribes preferred shut heights for mechanical presses. 

2. Terminology 

2.1 Shut Height — The distance from the top of the bed to the bottom of the slide with stroke down 
and adjustment up. 

2.1.1 The shut height shall be specified at maximum stroke in case of presses with adjustable stroke. 

3. Shut Heights— The preferred shut heights in millimetres for mechanical presses shall be as given 
below: 



100 


(112) 


125 


(140) 


160 


(180) 


200 


(224) 


250 


(280) 


315 


355 


400 


450 


500 &c, 


560 


630 


710 


800 


900 


1000 




;:&&' 





Note 1 — Shut heights less than 100 mm or more than 1 000 mm may be chosen from R20 preferred series as given 
in IS : 1076 - 1967 ' Preferred numbers ( first revision ) '. 

Note 2 — Size given In bracket is non-preferred. 



• 

Q 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared with a view to rationalize the shut heights of mechanical 
presses based on the experience of the Indian industry. 



Adopted 28 September 1983
